audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 6 read Skill on the full layer but Cassiopeia on the content layer and the packet, and rows 0-2 read Skill on both layers while every why on both layers says Talon threatens a kill in those levels — with Cassiopeia at 46.36% over 796 games the chart gave nobody the early lane.
audit.why: The packet explicitly flags the chart as too generous for a 46.36% win rate, and the existing whys[0..2] already argue Talon's brush dive wins levels 1-3.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 moved to Talon on BOTH layers (side + win[N] in the same proposal) with the phases whys rewritten to match; rows 3 and 6 moved to Cassiopeia on the full layer to match win[N], which was already correct. Row 4 left as Skill on both layers.

audit.why: Level 3 full combo, Shadow Assault at 6 (100/80/60), first DoT item and full build are the real spikes.
audit.corrected: Left spikes[0..2]; corrected only spikes[3]'s unsupported reveal claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things: the page never stated which of his abilities Miasma actually shuts off, and it twice claimed Petrifying Gaze REVEALS him during Shadow Assault.
audit.why: Noxian Diplomacy leaps at a target outside melee range and Assassin's Path vaults terrain — both are movement abilities, and grounded enemies cannot use movement abilities. Nothing in Cassiopeia's kit grants stealth reveal; her R stuns enemies facing her. Talon emerges from Invisibility on his own when the blades converge.
audit.corrected: Stated that Miasma denies both the Q leap and the vault, that Assassin's Path itself has no cooldown (only the used terrain does), and replaced the reveal claim with stunning him the instant he reappears.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and the packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: It is the field that must carry real numbers.
audit.corrected: Rake 9s at rank 1, Noxian Diplomacy 8s and 575 range, Assassin's Path free on cooldown but gated by the wall, plus a 'step up only when' line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Talon can vault a wall to cut off a retreat and Cassiopeia has no dash — never mentioned. Two bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes.

edits.before: Q poke on his last-hits — the poison-into-E pattern starts at level 1 and your DPS already out-trades most mids.
edits.after: Noxian Diplomacy leaps from 575 and a brush dive beats your delayed Q at level 1 — hold your range and do not trade.

edits.before: W changes the geometry: miasma GROUNDS dashes. Drop it on his engage path and the lane's mobility advantage evaporates.
edits.after: Miasma grounds dashes, so his Q leap and Assassin's Path both die inside it — but at 2 he still has Rake's return damage.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-poison into spammable E twin fangs is real sustained damage. Trade anyone who steps into Q range.
edits.after: At 3 his Q-W-E is whole and three stacks of Wound bleed you heavily; your poison ramp is not there yet.

edits.before: - Talon Rake: matchup-defining — The boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget R Petrifying Gaze for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Rake is 9s at rank 1 and the return blades carry the bonus damage — stand off the return line. - Noxian Diplomacy leaps from 575 every 8s; step up only after it. - Assassin's Path has no cooldown, only the wall does — Miasma grounds both.

edits.before: Talon wins by landing Rake, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Talon wins by vaulting a wall you cannot follow, opening with the Q leap, and bleeding you with three Wound stacks.

edits.before: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Talon is executable.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing you, so turn into his engage instead of running — a 120s ultimate is worth a stun, not a slow.

edits.before: Talon whiffs Rake and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Your 850 Q outranges his 650 Rake — poke his farm approach.

edits.before: That is Talon’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Miasma is the only thing you own that stops his leap and vault.

edits.before: Your miasma is the anti-dive — spending it on poke means the next engage arrives ungrounded and you have no boots to run.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze slows enemies with their back turned and stuns only those facing you — running is how you downgrade your own ultimate.

edits.before: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: Noxian Diplomacy refunds cooldown on a kill and Assassin's Path costs nothing — chasing him is how the fight restarts on him.

edits.before: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long that his Q leap has already landed on you.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Talon is executable. Bad trade: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Talon is executable. Bad trade: spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long that his 8-second Q leap has already landed on you.

edits.before: Carry by DPS — no mid matches your damage-per-second from two items; your job is staying alive long enough to prove it.
edits.after: Carry by grounding: Miasma is the only tool that cancels his Q leap and his vault, and everything after that is just fangs.

edits.before: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit, zone Talon off the wave with fang threat, and call your jungler — your W makes every gank a guaranteed kill.
edits.after: Ahead, take his walls: ward the side brush, poison him on every last-hit, and hold Miasma for the moment he vaults in rather than for the wave.

edits.before: If Talon opens the score, reset expectations and respect Rake doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q-E clears and stay relevant through grounded peel.
edits.after: If Talon opens the score, respect the 8-second Q leap and stop standing beside walls he can vault. After a second kill, farm Q-E under tower and hold Miasma purely to break his engage.

edits.before: Full-build Cassiopeia kites and reveals his stealth engage, denying his best tool entirely
edits.after: Full-build Cassiopeia kites and stuns him the moment he reappears from Shadow Assault

edits.before: Full items, your kiting and sustained damage win extended fights, and Petrifying Gaze denies his stealth engage entirely by revealing and locking him down before he lands his combo.
edits.after: Full items, your kiting and sustained damage win extended fights, and Petrifying Gaze locks him down the instant the blades converge and Shadow Assault drops his invisibility on top of you.

edits.before: Ward brush aggressively and play safe distances pre-6 to avoid his dive-and-execute combo
edits.after: Hold Flash for the wall he vaults over to cut your retreat, not just for his burst damage

edits.before: Save Petrifying Gaze to reveal and lock him down mid-Shadow Assault before his burst lands
edits.after: Save Petrifying Gaze for the instant Shadow Assault ends and he reappears next to you

Rows 3 and 6 were full-layer Skill against content-layer Cassiopeia; I moved the full layer to match.
